stats: for metric_col, metric_label in metrics.items(): fig.add_trace(go.Scatter( x = players_df[stat], y = players_df[metric_col], mode='markers', text=players_df['Player'], name= f"{stat} vs "xaxis.title.text": f"{stat}", "yaxis.title.text": f"{metric_label}"}] )) trace_index += 1 fig.update_layout( updatemenus=[dict(active=0, buttons=buttons, x=0.5, y=1.15)], #title=f"{stats[0]} vs {list(metrics.values())[0]}", xaxis_title=stats[0], yaxis_title=list(metrics.values())[0], template="plotly_dark" ) fig.update_layout(margin=dict(t=100)) fig.show() ```
